source.snippet: Trying to see if there's a way to search somewhere on Facebook Marketplace or elsewhere for trending items that have been selling within the last month or two. More so, items that are trending within a set distance limit. Something kind of like what you can do on eBay where you can search an item and then filter for 'sold' items within the last 90 days.

problem_statement: Resellers and small retail buyers who source inventory on Facebook Marketplace have no equivalent to eBay's sold-item filter, making it impossible to validate local demand or spot trending categories before buying stock.
target_segment: Part-time and full-time resellers, thrift flippers, and small retail buyers who source locally via Facebook Marketplace
notes: Buyer is a reseller who uses Facebook Marketplace as a sourcing channel — recurring commercial activity with money at stake. Comparison to eBay's paid/premium data features signals familiarity with paying for market intelligence. A scraper-based or aggregator tool surfacing local FB Marketplace sell-through data could fill this gap. Signal is a single post with no upvotes, so strength kept at 2; needs corroboration from reseller communities (r/flipping, etc.).
